'''Bilal Coulibaly''' (born 26 July 2004) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Metropolitans 92]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].

==Early life==
Coulibaly grew up in [[Courbevoie]], [[France]] and began playing basketball for Courbevoie Sport Basket at age eight. He began playing for youth team of [[Levallois Sporting Club Basket]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/qui-est-bilal-coulibaly-lautre-pepite-des-metropolitans-92/|title=Qui est Bilal Coulibaly, l’autre pépite des Metropolitans 92?|website=bebasket.fr|date=January 19, 2023|access-date=April 25, 2023|language=French}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Coulibaly began playing professionally for [[Metropolitans 92]] in LNB Espoirs, the French under-21 league, in 2021. He began 2022–23 season playing for the Metropolitans 92 under-21 team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/le-mans/basket-elite-valentin-chery-et-bilal-coulibaly-etaient-en-mission-defensive-pendant-mets-92-msb-0089776a-ce45-11ed-8922-c50b96804298|title=Basket. Élite : Valentin Chery et Bilal Coulibaly étaient en mission défensive pendant Mets 92 - MSB|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=March 29, 2023|access-date=March 30, 2023|language=French}}</ref> He was promoted to the senior team after averaging 21.9 points, 2.6 steals, and 1.2 blocks per game in LNB Espoirs competition.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/international-spotlight-the-rise-of-bilal-coulibaly|title=International Spotlight: The Rise of Bilal Coulibaly|first=Ignacio|last=Rissotto|website=[[SI.com]]|date=February 19, 2023|access-date=March 30, 2023}}</ref> Coulibaly submitted paperwork to enter the [[2023 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36244098/bilal-coulibaly-joins-teammate-victor-wembanyama-nba-draft|title=Bilal Coulibaly joins teammate Victor Wembanyama in NBA draft|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 20, 2023|access-date=April 21, 2023}}</ref>

==National team career==
Coulibaly played for the [[France men's national under-19 basketball team|France national under-18 team]] in the [[2022 FIBA U18 European Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/insider/insider/story/_/id/34396935/the-top-11-nba-prospects-fiba-u18-european-championship|title=The top 11 NBA prospects at the FIBA U18 European Championship|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=August 15, 2022|access-date=April 25, 2023}}</ref> He averaged 7.7 points, 3.9 rebounds, and one assist over seven games as France finished in fifth place.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2023/04/20/metropolitans-92-bilal-coulibaly-2023-nba-mock-draft/|title=International prospect Bilal Coulibaly declares for 2023 NBA draft|first=Cody|last=Taylor|website=The Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=April 20, 2023|access-date=April 25, 2023}}</ref>
